title: Your Coffee Price Is Up 164 Percent

scenes.narration: Have you noticed your morning coffee getting much more expensive?

visual.text: Your Coffee Price Is Up 164 Percent

scenes.narration: Since the year 2000, ground coffee prices have soared.
We are looking at a massive 164% total increase.
That is significantly higher than the rise in general inflation.
The full story is on the channel.

title: Why Coffee Costs 2.6 Times More Now

scenes.narration: Ever wonder how much more you are paying for coffee today?

visual.text: Why Coffee Costs 2.6 Times More Now

scenes.narration: In January 2000, a pound of ground coffee cost $3.54.
By September 2026, that same pound jumped to $9.33.
That is 2.6 times the original price.
The full story is on the channel.
Is your coffee bill rising faster than everything else?
In that same window, general inflation grew just 5%.
Coffee is clearly accelerating away from normal price trends, rising 33% since January 2025.
The full story is on the channel.
